crm_notes: Inbound SMB lead — building chat-first support widget embedded in web app.
Primary complaint: EU users see slow responses. Customer assumed default would be nearest region; found requests routed to us-west by default in their test app.
They are price sensitive but prioritize perceived latency for end users (first-byte/streaming experience).
Customer uses single-turn conversations mostly (short context, 300-800 tokens per request depending on history).
Quote from product lead: "Users rage-quit after 4s. If we can't hit sub-1s perceived latency, retention drops."
They deployed via client-side JS widget and call backend proxy in GCP europe-west1 but API key was tested from a dev laptop in us-west; mismatch noted.
SE found some clients using 60s client-side timeout — causing long waits and poor UX; suggested 20s baseline for chat streaming and 10-15s for simple replies.
Customer asked for clear checklist: region selection, recommended timeout, prompt-length guidance, telemetry dashboard to monitor p50/p95 token latencies.
AE provided drive link with onboarding + perf playbook; customer requested a short POC script to validate eu region routing and streaming.
Budget: early-stage SMB ARR target low; likely to convert to paid once 1-2 week POC shows stable p95 under target.
Decision maker: Head of Product (Clara Nwosu) — cares about UX metrics and retention.
use_case_summary: Customer runs a lightweight chat-first support widget for SMB SaaS customers. Main goals: sub-1s perceived reply times for EU users, predictable p95 latency, cost controls to avoid over-spend as user volume grows.
perf_recommendations: Region choice: validate traffic egress and set model routing to eu-central-1 / eu-west-1 to reduce network RTT — run A/B test between eu and us regions to measure delta
Streaming: enable streaming responses in widget to reduce time-to-first-token; perceived latency down dramatically even if overall completion time similar
Client timeouts: use conservative client-side timeout of 20-30s for chat streaming, 8-12s for single-turn quick replies; implement exponential backoff for retries
Prompt length: keep system + user instruction + recent context < 512 tokens for common queries; truncate older history and cache static instructions off-model
Max tokens: set sensible max_new_tokens (e.g., 64-150) for chat replies to cap tail latency and cost
Prefetch/caching: cache common replies and FAQs at edge; use prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts to reduce repeat compute
Model variant: test smaller latency-optimized model variant for one-turn answers and fall back to larger model for long/complex threads
Observability: add token-level timing and region tag to logs; track p50/p95 per region and model to quickly identify regressions
current_technical_status: Customer reproduced issue — many dev requests originated from us-west causing cross-region RTT. SE confirmed hosting in europe reduces p50; p95 spikes remain under load. POC requested to validate streaming + region pinning.
objections_and_risks: Cost sensitivity for continuous full-powered model use; customer may try cheap single model but later need larger model for complex threads. Need to show unit economics and caching savings.
